definitions.title: First Partial Derivatives
definitions.statement: The partial derivative of f with respect to x is the ordinary derivative of f with respect to x holding y constant. Similarly, the partial derivative with respect to y holds x constant.
definitions.explanation: Geometrically, f_x(x_0, y_0) is the slope of the curve formed by intersecting surface z = f(x, y) with the vertical plane y = y_0.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Measures instantaneous rate of change in direction of coordinate axes.

definitions.title: Clairaut's Theorem (Equality of Mixed Partials)
definitions.latex: f_{xy}(x, y) = f_{yx}(x, y) \quad \left( \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y \partial x} = \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x \partial y} \right)
definitions.statement: If the mixed second-order partial derivatives f_{xy} and f_{yx} are continuous on an open disk containing (x_0, y_0), then they are equal at that point.
conditions: f_{xy} and f_{yx} are continuous on open region
definitions.explanation: The order of partial differentiation does not matter for smooth functions.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Mixed partial derivatives commute under continuity.
